emails.subject: URGENT: Friday kampong egg delivery delayed to 12pm noon
emails.text:
Hi Wei Ling,

Paiseh, our main chilled lorry broke down at the Tuas checkpoint inspection. For Friday 17 November, we can only deliver your 80 trays of Grade A kampong eggs to Raffles Place by 12:00pm noon instead of 6:30am.

If you need eggs for the 8:00am breakfast rush, you will need to source backup trays for the morning wave, or move your $1 Set A launch promo to Monday morning.

Regards,
Uncle Lim
Ah Seng Poultry Farm

emails.subject: Re: Friday 8am TikTok Livestream at Nanyang Kopi Raffles Place
emails.text:
Hey Daniel!

Super hyped for the Nanyang Kopi & Toast flagship launch! My standard rate for a 1-hour TikTok Live + Reel (85k followers) is SGD 600.

Since I love your kaya butter toast, I can do a special buddy rate of SGD 450 if you throw in 20 of those cute Kaya Toast plushie keychains and 20 Set A vouchers for my comment-section giveaway. Let me know today so I can lock my Friday morning schedule!

Cheers,
Zack (@MakanWithZack)

emails.subject: Storefront queue lane restriction - Unit #B1-14
emails.text:
Dear Tenant (Nanyang Kopi & Toast),

Please note that for your Friday morning promotion, your queue stanchions must stay strictly within the 3m x 2m boundary directly in front of Unit #B1-14.

Under fire safety rules, queues may not spill past the B1 central escalator landing. Please station a staff marshal or use mobile pre-ordering so the corridor stays clear.

Centre Management
